g.text: Vibe P4: more solving changed the destruction

g.text: Orange dashed line: 60 Hz budget (16.667 ms). Left labels give the range of process means.
Left: restore itself is excluded, but the next solve rebuilds disposable state; first ticks retained.
Right: Sep 4 single runs, 45 simulated seconds, 26 shots; 256 arms also use incremental topology. Not an isolated iteration test.
P4 command requests 30 settle ticks; setup/warmup is not covered by this chart. Raw P4 traces were not available locally.
